description: Language-agnostic vectors of the extruded solid's `sweep` (D47), hand-computed on the sample figure at 1:100 in the pose `stand`: the thigh bone `thigh-l` hangs down from the origin, so its u axis is world -y (down), its normal v is world +x (ahead) and its lateral axis w is world +z (left). One rect profile (x 0..0.45 along the bone, y 0..0.05) is swept from z0 = -0.2 to z1 = 0.3. sweep `w` puts the profile in the (u, v) plane and the thickness along w: front shows x = z0..z1 (the lateral span) and y = -0.45..0 (the profile along the bone); plan shows x = 0..0.05 (the profile's second axis, along v) and y = z0..z1. sweep `v` puts the profile in the (u, w) plane and the thickness along v: front shows x = 0..0.05 (the profile's second axis, along w) and y = -0.45..0, plan shows x = z0..z1 (the thickness along v, ahead) and y = 0..0.05. A missing sweep has no default and is refused.

cases.name: sweep w: the profile lies in the (u, v) plane and the thickness runs laterally
sweep v: the profile lies in the (u, w) plane and the thickness runs along the bone normal
